derivation_note: D54 requires every analytic target be derived twice. My independent derivation gives 2.060036 at alpha=0.70; the FT-A review quoted 2.0516 -- a 0.4% difference. I score against my own derivation and flag the disagreement rather than silently adopting either.
verdict: PASS against the exact target at both operating points (alpha=0.30: +0.09%, alpha=0.70: +3.24%)

d54_limit_statement.limit: the value 2 is the xi -> 0 limit of 2*artanh(xi)/xi

severity_correction: B4 is upheld -- the invariance claim was false and the gate passed against a target that is only a limit. But its PRACTICAL severity was overstated: the limit error at the tested points is 0.26% and 2.91%, both comfortably inside the original +/-0.20 band (i.e. +/-10%), and even at alpha=0.80 it is 5.07%. The limit would not break a +/-10% band until alpha > ~0.9. So the original gate would NOT have failed a correct solver at any alpha this project uses -- it would merely have passed for a slightly wrong reason.
